## NODE char_achilles Character "Achilles" "Iliad" "book 1"
summary: Greatest Greek warrior in the Trojan War, son of the goddess Thetis and the mortal Peleus; his rage is the subject of the Iliad.

## NODE char_hector Character "Hector" "Iliad" "book 6"
summary: Prince of Troy and its greatest defender; son of Priam, slain by Achilles in single combat.

## NODE char_priam Character "Priam" "Iliad" "book 24"
summary: King of Troy during the war; father of Hector and Paris; ransoms his son's body from Achilles.

## NODE char_paris Character "Paris" "Iliad" "book 3"
summary: Trojan prince whose abduction of Helen sparked the Trojan War; judged the beauty contest that started it all.

## NODE char_helen Character "Helen" "Iliad" "book 3"
summary: Wife of Menelaus, taken to Troy by Paris; her face launched a thousand ships.

## NODE char_agamemnon Character "Agamemnon" "Iliad" "book 1"
summary: King of Mycenae and commander of the Greek forces; his quarrel with Achilles drives the Iliad's plot.

## NODE char_thetis Character "Thetis" "Iliad" "book 1"
summary: Sea goddess, mother of Achilles; intercedes with Zeus on her son's behalf.

## NODE char_zeus Character "Zeus" "Iliad" "book 1"
summary: King of the gods who weighs the fates of Greeks and Trojans on his golden scales.

## NODE char_athena Character "Athena" "Iliad" "book 1"
summary: Goddess of wisdom and warfare; champion of the Greeks, especially Achilles and Diomedes.

## NODE char_patroclus Character "Patroclus" "Iliad" "book 16"
summary: Achilles' closest companion; wore Achilles' armor into battle and was slain by Hector.

## NODE place_troy Place "Troy" "Iliad" "book 1"
summary: The walled city of King Priam, besieged by the Greeks for ten years.

## NODE place_mycenae Place "Mycenae" "Iliad" "book 1"
summary: The fortified city of Agamemnon, the muster point of the Greek expedition.

## NODE event_trojan_war Event "The Trojan War" "Iliad" "book 1"
summary: A ten-year siege of Troy by the Greek forces, triggered by Paris's abduction of Helen.

## NODE event_duel_hector Event "Duel of Achilles and Hector" "Iliad" "book 22"
summary: The climactic single combat outside the walls of Troy in which Achilles kills Hector.

## NODE obj_armor Object "Armor of Achilles" "Iliad" "book 18"
summary: Divine armor forged by Hephaestus for Achilles after Patroclus fell wearing his original set.

## NODE concept_kleos Concept "Kleos" "Iliad" "book 9"
summary: The Greek concept of glory and immortal fame won through heroic deeds in battle.
